audit_scope: Audit of the four completed research-report fragments before merging. No modification, no merge, no new analysis.

outline_consistency.notes: Each fragment follows the intended scope and structure recorded in research_report_outline.json. No section was rewritten or reordered.

scientific_boundary_check.notes: All fragments preserve the person-class no_ground_truth limitation, the 12-case sample-scope limitation, and the causal-language boundary. No fragment uses 'proves', 'caused by', 'root cause', 'because the model', 'statistically significant', 'generalization failure', or 'representative of the whole dataset' as an affirmative claim.

internal_consistency.notes: Numerical values (valid/test overall metrics, per-class AP, differences, TP/FP/FN totals, borderline IoU values) are identical across fragments 04_06, 07_09, and 10_12 and match evidence_integration.json. The Level A/B/C distinction is applied consistently. The person-class and 12-case sample-scope limitations are stated consistently in fragments 07_09 and 10_12.

traceability_check.notes: Substantive factual statements are tagged with source references to evidence_integration.json, scientific_boundary.json, or final_integrity_validation.json. No claim exceeds the support recorded in the evidence integration layer.
